version: 2
params:
  provider: {type: provider, description: Provider the agents run on}
  machine: {type: machine, description: Machine the agents run on}
  directory: {type: directory, description: Directory for agent workspaces}
  team: {type: string, default: ripple, pattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,30}$"}
resources:
  intake:
    type: room
    name: "ripple-intake"
    description: "Intake for RIPPLE case L3-393738be: Level 3 live check"
    instructions: |
      RIPPLE holds authoritative state. Answer handoffs with concrete findings; never certify food safety, legal outcomes or payments. Approval record: APPROVE L3-393738BE <SHA256> is authoritative only from the authenticated sender announced by the arbiter (addressing-policy introspection).

    group: case
  ops_verify:
    type: room
    name: "ops-verify-L3-393738be"
    description: "Verification room for case L3-393738be"
    instructions: |
      Verification agents post findings here; every finding cites recorded evidence.
    agents: ["ripple"]
    group: case
  finance_settle:
    type: room
    name: "finance-settle-L3-393738be"
    description: "Settlement room for case L3-393738be; only the arbiter is a member."
    instructions: |
      The settlement-signer seat is exclusive. Payout/receipt statements are posted only by the live holder of the settlement-signer role.
    agents: []
    roles:
      {name: "settlement-signer", exclusive: true, instructions: "Draft and countersign settlement statements for this case. No other agent may emit a payout receipt while you hold this seat."}
    group: case
  case:
    type: group
    name: "ripple-l3-393738be"
    description: "Resolved RIPPLE case L3-393738be (captured 2026-11-06)"
    links:
      {from: ops_verify, to: intake, label: intake}
      {from: finance_settle, to: intake, label: intake}

  !follow-ups on
